Case studies need a visible beginning and end. The extension places a complete
section inside one box while keeping its heading available to the table of
contents and cross-references.

## Before the case

The paragraph before the marked heading remains outside the box. See
@sec-factory-schedule for the complete example.

## Formulating a factory schedule {#sec-factory-schedule .case-study}

A small factory must complete two orders using one cutting machine and one
finishing machine. Each machine can process one order at a time.

| Order | Cut | Finish | Required order |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| A | 2 hours | 1 hour | Cut, then finish |
| B | 1 hour | 2 hours | Finish, then cut |

The scheduling problem records the steps, durations, ordering rules, and
machine capacity. The time when both orders are complete is the *makespan*.

### A question for later

How would the schedule change if Order A needed two hours on the finishing
machine?
